title: Implement AlphaTemplate and seed it from Qlib Alpha158 and Alpha101

acceptance_criteria_verification.contract_and_registry_storage: alpha_template.v1.schema.json carries the plan 3.3 fields (plus `parameters` holding const_param values). ArtifactType.ALPHA_TEMPLATE; POST /api/registry/alpha-templates, GET /api/registry/alpha-templates[/{id}] (filters family/scope/status/library); generic POST /entries rejects the kind; built-in library registered idempotently at startup. Proof: test_registry_store_and_list, test_http_store_list_and_generic_route_rejection.
acceptance_criteria_verification.alpha158_reference_parity: 158 templates (9 KBAR + 4 PRICE + 29 rolling ops x windows 5/10/20/30/60) in alpha_templates/qlib_alpha158.v1.json. test_alpha158_matches_reference_on_fixture compares all 158 against an independent pure-Python implementation of the Qlib definitions on a seeded 140-bar OHLCV fixture at 3 bars, rel tol 1e-8. Qlib sample-std (ddof=1) is reproduced via std_scale=sqrt(d/(d-1)); Qlib Rank via (ts_rank*(d-1)+1)/d; IMAX/IMIN tie-break differs (latest bar) but not on non-tied fixture data.
acceptance_criteria_verification.alpha101: 13 time-series formulas (#6,#7,#9,#12,#23,#26,#35,#41,#43,#46,#53,#54,#101) implemented from the paper text; value-checked against direct formulas where independent of Ts_Rank, finite-checked otherwise (Ts_Rank is the normalised percentile). 11 cross-sectional formulas (#2,#3,#4,#13,#14,#28,#32,#33,#40,#44,#55) stored with scope=cross_sectional; evaluate_alpha_template refuses them and factor_rule's per-symbol parser rejects their AST (test_cross_sectional_templates_stored_and_refused).
acceptance_criteria_verification.origin_licence_attribution: Every template carries origin{library,ref}, licence (MIT for Qlib; arXiv formula attribution for Alpha101) and attribution; test_every_template_validates_and_carries_provenance and test_no_gpl_or_noncommercial_material. No OSAP/JKP code or data is included; no Qlib code is copied or imported.
